summary.text: Use CPF’s Healthcare dashboard to view MediSave and MediShield Life claim details for the past 15 months.

details.heading: Claims older than 15 months
details.body: For claims before the past 15 months, submit a request to the Central Provident Fund Board through the CPF website.

steps.name: Sign in
steps.text: Log in to your Healthcare dashboard under my cpf digital services with your Singpass.

steps.name: Open claims
steps.text: Go to “Latest healthcare payments and claims”.

steps.name: Choose a period
steps.text: Select the hospitalisation period you want to view.

steps.name: Open the details
steps.text: Click the amount under MediSave Payment or MediShield Life/Integrated Shield Plan Payment to see the claim details.

quotes.text: You can view the details of your MediSave withdrawals and MediShield Life claim details for past 15 months online at www.cpf.gov.sg under "Latest healthcare payments and claims".
(1) Login to your Healthcare dashboard under my cpf digital services with your Singpass
(2) Proceed to “Latest healthcare payments and claims”
(5) Click on the amount at MediSave Payment or MediShield Life/Integrated Shield Plan Payment to view the claim details.
If you would like to view the details of claims prior to the past 15 months, please submit a request to the Central Provident Fund Board via www.cpf.gov.sg/eSvc/Web/FeedbackSubscription/Index .
